prompt:
Image 1 is a reference sheet of 3D clay icons. Copy its style exactly: soft 3D clay with chubby rounded forms and a matte finish, gentle studio light from the top left, the same straight-on camera angle seen very slightly from above, and the same soft pastel palette (cream, mint, peach, sky blue, butter yellow) with a warm coral accent.
Draw exactly one object: a chunky rounded cream stone archway gate with two small sky-blue doors standing half open, and a butter-yellow crescent moon resting on top of the arch, with one small coral lantern hanging in the opening.
Center it upright, not tilted, and let it fill about 80 percent of the square canvas with even margins on all sides. Transparent background. No floor, no contact shadow, no cast shadow. No text, no letters, no numbers, no faces, no other objects, no grid, no frame.
It must stay recognizable at 16 pixels: a bold simple silhouette made of only a few large parts.
